In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)=\operatorname{arcoth}⁡(x)$ and $v(x)=\sqrt{x}.$

Therefore, we apply the product rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{{[v(x)]}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{(\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x)}^{′}\cdot \sqrt{x}-\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x\cdot {(\sqrt{x})}^{′}}{{(\sqrt{x})}^{2}} \\  & =\frac{{(\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x)}^{′}\cdot \sqrt{x}}{x}-\frac{\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x\cdot {(\sqrt{x})}^{′}}{x} \\  & =(\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}})\cdot \frac{\sqrt{x}}{x}-\frac{\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x}{x}\cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} \\  & =(\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}})\cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}-\frac{\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x}{2x}\cdot \frac{1}{\sqrt{x}} \\  & =\frac{1}{\sqrt{x}}(\frac{1}{1-{x}^{2}}-\frac{\operatorname{arcoth}⁡x}{2x}).\end{aligned}
$$
